author: Zintenka
body:
We're all about creativity and gameplay! Join us, and you will have fun building with us.

Rules:

  • No shutting down ones' ideas harshly. Respectfully tell them why their idea might not be good.
  • No trolling.
  • When building, take into account if the build will interfere with gameplay or not.
  • Look for good and fair builders and ask them if they wish to join. Bring them to me, vsplesk101, and TheHoopsman for evaluation. Or if one or more are absent consent either one or two.
  • Must have high tolerance level.
  • After the map is finished and a forum post is created, you may greif, PVP, or lollygag around in the map. (I greif my maps after i finish them... dont judge me!)

Members:

  • Zintenka
  • vsplesk101
  • TheHoopsman
  • AwarriorVenom/Exzy
  • Evocal
  • itaity
  • TheRomanTrident
  • Slicorn
  • EricV4
  • Arachadonic
  • TheMasterCow/Paraspider

Ranks:

  • Architectus (Master Builders, leaders of the build team)
Zintenka
vsplesk101
TheHoopsman

  • Exemplary Cartographer (Gained through being a naturally good mapmaker)
AwarriorVenom/Exzy
Evocal
TheMasterCow
itaity
  • Veteran Cartographer (Long time service mapmaker with maps that look good)
Slicorn

  • Hardened Cartographer (Built several maps together with us is higher than Veteran and Exemplary.) 


  • Cartographer (Just joined, rank can be skipped to either Veteran if one or two Architectus recognizes your build. Rank can be skipped to Exemplary Cartographer if 2 other Exemplaries notice your awesome work and if all Architectus notice your work OR... if you have at least 3 maps in the rotations.)
TheRomanTrident
EricV4
Arachadonic
Slvrflash
